g.text: Pages, navigation, data source pulls and tech stack
Expo Router + React Native + Express + Supabase
Generated from the local Stackr codebase

text.tspan: Live pulls, catalogue data and image sources
PokeTrace sold comps and price history
eBay Browse API and SerpAPI sold listings
Stripe payment intents for trades/buy now
Discord webhooks for bug reports, reviews and feedback
price-refresh lanes: queued, listings, chase, high-value,
Runtime, UI, native and backend layers
Vision Camera, ML Kit OCR, ONNX Runtime
Rev2 PNG assets and Stackr design components
Home -> Collection Value -> Value History -> Market movers -> Card detail
Collection Vault -> Binder Detail -> Scan to Binder / Add Cards -> Card Detail -> Price panel
Scan -> Identify card -> Add to binder / Create Listing / Inventory stock-in / Search market
Market -> Listing -> Offer / Trade / Watchlist -> Notifications and Discord events
Search -> Card, Set, Product, User or Listing -> Binder, Market or Community routes
Listing New -> Item -> Details -> Value -> Protection -> Photos -> Publish / seller listings
Foreign card path -> TCGdex language -> set -> card -> image/pricing -> Supabase cache optional
Shipping path -> listing/order -> Shippo rates -> label -> tracking -> buyer notification

g.text: Notes: diagnostic/legacy routes are shown only where still present in the backend layer. Supabase is both a direct client data source and backend persistence layer. Foreign Pokemon card support is currently routed through TCGdex.
